/*selectMasterMdAmMsdsList*/ SELECT MSDS_NO ,DESCRIPTION ,SPECIFICATION ,UNIT_MEASURE ,MAKER_NAME ,ORIGIN_CODE ,(SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = A.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NM , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',1) AS CAS_NO_1 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',2) AS CAS_NO_2 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',3) AS CAS_NO_3 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',4) AS CAS_NO_4 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',5) AS CAS_NO_5 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',6) AS CAS_NO_6 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',7) AS CAS_NO_7 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',8) AS CAS_NO_8 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',9) AS CAS_NO_9 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',10) AS CAS_NO_10 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',11) AS CAS_NO_11 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',12) AS CAS_NO_12 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',13) AS CAS_NO_13 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',14) AS CAS_NO_14 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',15) AS CAS_NO_15 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',16) AS CAS_NO_16 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',17) AS CAS_NO_17 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',18) AS CAS_NO_18 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',19) AS CAS_NO_19 , F_SPLIT(A.CAS_NO,'/',20) AS CAS_NO_20 , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = A.ADD_USER_ID ) AS ADD_USER_NM ,ADD_USER_ID ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,LAST_REVISION_DATE ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ,CMC_HARMFUL_YN ,MSDS_SUBMISSION_NUMBER
FROM KEPMSDSHD A WHERE 1=1
AND UPPER(A.MSDS_NO) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_msds_no}||'%')
AND UPPER(A.DESCRIPTION) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_description}||'%')
AND UPPER(A.SPECIFICATION) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_specification}||'%')
AND UPPER(A.CAS_NO) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_cas_no}||'%')
AND UPPER(A.MAKER_NAME) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_maker_name}||'%')
AND A.MSDS_SUBMISSION_NUMBER LIKE UPPER('%'|| #{st_submission_number} || '%') AND TRIM(A.MSDS_SUBMISSION_NUMBER) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY A.MSDS_NO
